name: Impenetrable Shaftcollar
description: Hold the orb low on one side and the shaft high on the other, as two rivers about to meet.

name: Ballwrath
description: Swing the orb so its path forks around the foe's guard, striking whichever side he leaves open.

name: Burrflash
description: Step so that the body arrives at the same instant as the orb, the two paths joining at the target.

name: Strangling Prickball
description: Hook a spike on the foe's weapon and pull against its swing, like a swimmer against a current.

name: Pummelruin
description: Send two streams of qi, one down the shaft and one into the orb, so both land together on impact.

name: Unbowed Spikering
description: Spread the guard like the channels of a delta, turning aside several quick cuts one after another.

name: Mayhem Pummel
description: Bring the orb down in a broad flat sweep that spreads its force across every foe in the front arc.

name: Harnessing Topspike
description: Pin the foe's weapon between orb and shaft and hold it with both streams of qi until he lets go.

name: Devastating Thornbite
description: Let both streams of qi build in the orb for a breath and break together, hammering the foe to the ground.

name: Invincible Spikebase
description: Wait with the head raised and the shaft slanted, still as a hawk on its perch.

name: Clairvoyant Headspike
description: Fix the eyes on the weak point in the foe's armor and read the stance behind it before the swing.

name: Crunchruin
description: Heave the head upward on a rising swing that catches a foe under the chin.

name: Berserk Topspike
description: Jab the topmost spike down like a hawk's beak into the join of neck and shoulder plate.

name: Impervious Ballsocket
description: Beat the haft against an incoming cut with a sharp flick, sending it wide like a pinion feather.

name: Burrhavoc
description: Lay a line of qi down the shaft ahead of the swing, so the head falls through it already heavy.

name: Thistlevalor
description: Drop the head behind the shield-arm side and raise the shaft to cover the body from above.

name: Rampaging Studball
description: Gather qi for a breath and bring the head down in a fall that hits like rain driven by a storm.

name: Webbing Spikering
description: Sink the spike through the foe's sleeve into the arm beneath and seize it, holding his weapon down.

name: Eviscerating Glint Headspike
description: Stoop from above with the head loaded to the full, driving a spike through plate and the body behind it.

name: Unassailable Shaftcollar
description: Hold the orb and the shaft apart, each covering the line the other does not.

name: Pitiless Topspike
description: Lead with the capped end of the shaft and follow with the orb on the same line.

name: Maulwrath
description: Lead with the orb to draw the foe's guard and let the shaft finish what the orb opened.

name: Flintlike Ballsocket
description: While the orb is out, bring the shaft across to turn a counterstroke away from the open side.

name: Thistlescourge
description: After the shaft has caught a blade, swing the orb round to strike the wielder at once.

name: Overbearing Prickball
description: Close orb and shaft on either side of the foe's weapon like shears and hold it fast.

name: Confluent Studcrush
description: Rotate orb and shaft around the hands in a balanced circle, each striking where the other has just left.

name: Lacerating Spikeball
description: Charge both ends of the weapon with qi and strike with orb and cap at once, so the shock doubles.

name: Burrscourge
description: Strike with one end and parry with the other in the same beat, so the exchange is won on both sides.

name: Booming Headspike
description: Open from a high guard with a long falling swing that begins the round.

name: Evergreen Spikering
description: Rise on the toes and lift the shaft to cover the head as an attacker falls on the user.

name: Thistlehavoc
description: Sweep the head flat along the line of the foe's shoulders as if drawing a horizon.

name: Pummelglimmer
description: Drift to the foe's flank behind the orb's swing, as a cloudbank crosses a ridge.

name: Crunchscourge
description: Knock the head across the edge of a raised helm, jarring the head beneath.

name: Titanic Spikedrop
description: Drop the loaded head from the full height of the round in a bright, heavy arc.

name: Crunchvortex
description: Chase the foe downhill in running strides, the head swinging at each landing.

name: Adamantine Topspike
description: Lift the shaft to a high ledge-like guard and turn a downward cut off its edge.

name: Reverberating Maul
description: Run the opening, rise, sweep and drop of the round without a pause, each stroke feeding the next.

name: Ferocious Spikebase
description: Plunge a spike through a gap opened by the sweep, as a bird dives through a mountain pass.

name: Shattering Thornball
description: Raise the orb to the top of its arc, let qi fill it for a breath, then crush straight down.

name: Indomitable Spikeball
description: Stand with the weight of the body settled and the shaft held across it as the first track of power.

name: Corroding Studball
description: Reach the orb out on the line the field of qi has already marked, the second track of power.

name: Maulglare
description: Move forward in parallel to the foe so his weapon passes along the orb's line, not through it.

name: Maulhavoc
description: Pivot on the lead foot and let the orb drop over the shoulder onto the foe's raised weapon.

name: Blistering Headspike
description: Run body qi through the arms and field qi through the shaft, then bring both to the head.

name: Obdurate Shaftcollar
description: Throw a screen of field qi across the front while the shaft guards in the usual way.

name: Numbing Topspike
description: Hook the foe's weapon on one track of motion and strike on the other before he can recover.

name: Vengeful Spikering
description: Send two pulses of qi into the head a fraction apart so the second drives through where the first landed.

name: Multiplying Pummel
description: Swap the roles of body and field qi mid-round so the guard becomes the strike without a gap.

name: Titanic Facet Spikering
description: Merge body and field qi in the leading spike and drive it through the foe's guard and armor.

name: Unconquered Spikebase
description: Stand low and wide, shaft before the chest, holding the court's basin posture for the fall to come.

name: Ballscourge
description: Cut at the upper rim of the foe's guard so the head spills down into the opening.

name: Thistleflash
description: Drag the feet in a low shuffle that keeps the orb steady on its line.

name: Unrelenting Shaftcollar
description: Channel a cut off the shaft sideways, like a tributary leaving the main stream.

name: Pummelscourge
description: Strike into the gap left by the previous blow before the foe can close it.

name: Suffocating Headspike
description: Press down on the foe's weapon with the shaft and orb, holding it in the hollow of the guard.

name: Escalating Studcrush
description: Drop the head twice in close succession, the second fall filling the gap the first one made.

name: Unsparing Thornbite
description: Build qi in the orb and break the foe's guard rim with a fall that scatters his weapon and stance.

name: Pummelhavoc
description: Bring a fully loaded orb down on the foe's centre at the end of a filling guard, ending the exchange.

name: Inexorable Spikering
description: Face the foe with the shaft angled forward, shoulders turned like a sail to the wind.

name: Gnashing Topspike
description: Cut down hard along the line sworn at the start of the exchange, never wavering from it.

name: Burrglimmer
description: Step across the foe's line as a crosswind crosses a road, with the head following.

name: Maulscourge
description: Slap the flat of the shaft hard against the foe's weapon hand to loosen the grip.

name: Burrwrath
description: Wait out the foe's rhythm, then break it with a sudden loaded swing, as a gust breaks a lull.

name: Obdurate Prickball
description: Veer the shaft aside at the last moment so a thrust passes over the user like wind over a ridge.

name: Maiming Ballsocket
description: Hook a spike on the foe's cloak and tear it across his eyes to blind him for a moment.

name: Silt Thornball
description: Whirl the orb round the body in a ring of qi, driving back every foe near the user.

name: Synchronized Spikeball
description: Chase a retreating foe in long strides with a swing at each, never letting him set his stance.

name: Merciless Headspike
description: Hold the swing at its peak while qi gathers like a held gale, then bring it down and leave the foe pinned.

name: Impervious Topspike
description: Plant both feet wide and bend the knees, shaft back, ready to throw the weight forward.

name: Crunchwrath
description: Drive straight at the foe into the wind of his attack, swinging the head down at his shoulder.

name: Ballvortex
description: Drift sideways across open ground, away from the foe's strongest line, with the head swinging free.

name: Ballruin
description: Hammer the head forward with a rush of qi like the front of a squall line.

name: Unbudging Thornball
description: Turn the shaft into a spinning guard whose qi throws attackers wide.

name: Ruinous Prickball
description: Find a gap in the foe's armor as wind finds a gap in a roof and drive a spike home.

name: Slag Studcrush
description: Sweep the orb across the whole front in an arc that crushes whatever stands within it.

name: Overpowering Spikebase
description: Lean the shaft across the foe and press, with a steady flow of qi, until his weapon is trapped.

name: Berserk Pummel
description: Gather a gale of qi in the head over a breath and let it break on the foe in a single crushing blow.

name: Evergreen Ballsocket
description: Speak the sworn word under the breath and take a still stance, shaft raised.

name: Thistlewrath
description: Bring the head down on the very spot named in the oath.

name: Pummelblink
description: Advance along the straight line of the oath, refusing to give the foe a flank.

name: Enthralling Shaftcollar
description: Press the haft over the foe's weapon and hold it down for the length of a breath.

name: Prescient Thornball
description: Take a measured breath and read the foe's balance before committing the stroke.

name: Wrathful Spikeball
description: Bind the swing to the sworn line with qi so the head can neither swerve nor lag as it falls.

name: Flintlike Headspike
description: Keep the guard on the sworn side and turn aside every cut that comes along it.

name: Immobilizing Topspike
description: Anchor the head on the foe's weapon with a hard drop and drag it down by its own weight.

name: Overlapping Maul
description: Bring the head down twice on the sworn line, the second blow riding the echo of the first.

name: Hogtying Spikering
description: Lodge a spike in the foe's armor and keep the shaft pressed to the line, holding him to the oath.

name: Rampaging Prickball
description: Speak the vow, let qi pour into the head, and drop it with a single spike sinking through armor.

name: Unerring Shaftcollar
description: Sight along the shaft to the foe's weak point and hold that bearing steady.

name: Ferocious Thornbite
description: Lunge to the farthest reach of the shaft with a single spike aimed at the sighted point.

name: Burrblink
description: Retreat or advance a half-pace at a time so the foe stays exactly at the range of the head.

name: Hellish Pummel
description: Sweep the head along the sighted bearing without letting it drift as the foe shifts.

name: Adamantine Spikebase
description: Turn the long shaft to knock a thrust aside well before it can reach the body.

name: Strangling Spikeball
description: Throw the head out to its full reach and snare the foe's weapon on a spike, drawing it in.

name: Decimating Prickball
description: Gather qi along the held bearing and let the head fall straight down it onto the sighted spot.

name: Gnashing Headspike
description: Hold the line while the foe moves, then drive a qi-sharpened spike through plate at the sighted joint.

name: Unsparing Iron Spikebase
description: At the outermost length of the shaft, land the loaded spike on the sighted point before the foe's weapon arrives.

name: Unbowed Shaftcollar
description: Stand with nothing at the back and the shaft level, ready for a blow from any side.

name: Ballhavoc
description: Swing the orb in a full circle where no cover blocks it, striking whatever steps into the ring.

name: Crunchglare
description: Stride wide across open ground, shifting the line of the swing with the feet.

name: Pitiless Spikering
description: Turn so the wind is at the back and strike forward, the swing pushed along by it.

name: Mayhem Studball
description: Whirl the orb through every direction in turn so no attacker has a safe side.

name: Unconquered Headspike
description: Turn the guard to wherever the threat comes from, never leaning on cover or an edge.

name: Webbing Prickball
description: Hook the foe's weapon at the far reach of the shaft and pull it to one side, away from the line of attack.

name: Escalating Pummel
description: Strike from three sides in turn, moving round the foe, each swing carrying the next.

name: Vengeful Spikeball
description: Bring the orb in a great loaded sweep that strikes every foe at the wielder's sides and front.

name: Titanic Ballsocket
description: Lift the orb high and let qi gather round it in the open air, then drop it to pin the whole front.

name: Impenetrable Spikebase
description: Hold the shaft across the front like the edge of a plateau, steady against any weight.

name: Corroding Topspike
description: Lead with the spike at the head of the orb, aiming for a weak plate or sleeve.

name: Thistleglimmer
description: Slide the hands along the shaft with a step, changing the reach as the foe closes.

name: Booming Spikedrop
description: Cut with the length of the shaft, driven on a gale of qi, so the whole weapon strikes as one.

name: Indomitable Prickball
description: Knock a cut away with a gust of qi from the shaft, then turn the spike toward the foe.

name: Maiming Shaftcollar
description: Lock the foe's weapon between shaft and spike and twist, holding it as in a vise.

name: Berserk Thornbite
description: Thrust the spike forward like a lance, backed by the full weight of a gale of qi.

name: Confluent Pummel
description: Pivot on one foot while thrusting, sweeping and pulling back in a single flow.

name: Brutalizing Headspike
description: Gather qi in shaft and spike over a held breath and drive both into the foe, pinning him to the ground.
